Bill.BriefDescription: Providing an exemption to the licensing requirement for apprentices in cosmetology registered industry apprenticeship programs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing an exemption to the licensingrequirement for apprentices in cosmetology registered industryapprenticeship programs; and amending RCW 18.16.070.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.16.070 and 1984 c 208 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter shall not apply to persons licensed under other lawsof this state who are performing services within their authorized scopeof practice and shall not be construed to require a license forstudents enrolled in a school or engaged in a registered industryapprenticeship program.
